preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 400 inclusive.
Each of the n lines after the first must contain exactly two integers (x, y).

preconditions.expression: all(abs(int(x)) <= 1000 and abs(int(y)) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each coordinate (x, y) must satisfy |x| ≤ 1000 and |y| ≤ 1000.

preconditions.expression: len({(int(x), int(y)) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.split()]}) == n
preconditions.description: All node coordinates must be distinct.

postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' (impossible) or a non-negative real number (total arc length).

postconditions.expression: all(yu > yv for (xu, yu), (xv, yv) in arcs) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If a valid tree exists, all arcs must be directed from top to bottom (yu > yv).

postconditions.expression: is_valid_binary_root_tree(nodes, arcs) if stdout.strip() != '-1' else True
postconditions.description: If a valid tree exists, the constructed tree must be a binary root tree with minimum total arc length.
